Agent Name: CSVHandling_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the game mechanics and assumed the first ball (in position 1) is most likely to be ejected. In fact, a ball in position 1 is ejected only if piston 1 fires (probability 1/3); if pistons 2 or 3 fire (2/3 of the time), it is released without ejection. Proper probabilistic analysis shows ball 3 (starting in position 3) has the highest ejection probability (17/27), exceeding ball 2 (5/9) and ball 1 (1/3).
